title: Webb County Treasurer Marks Deputy Viñals' Third Anniversary
excerpt: Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes recognized Chief Deputy County Treasurer Manuel Viñals on Monday, marking Viñals' third work anniversary with the Treasurer's Office and praising his leadership and dedication to public service.
content:
Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes recognized Chief Deputy County Treasurer Manuel Viñals on Monday, marking Viñals' third work anniversary with the Webb County Treasurer's Office.

Reyes said Viñals has shown dedication, professionalism and leadership over the past three years, and that his sound judgment and commitment to the office's responsibilities have been invaluable to the treasurer and the entire team.

Reyes said the strength of any organization lies in the people who help lead it, and credited Viñals with playing an important role in the success of the Treasurer's Office.

He thanked Viñals for his loyalty, friendship and leadership, and for his dedication to public service and to the people of Webb County.

Source: Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes, Nov. 16, 2026.
